blind_audit.rationale: ZAP70 is an intracellular kinase that acts downstream of the T-cell receptor. In ZAP70 deficiency, TCR-triggered responses are absent or markedly impaired, whereas stimuli such as phorbol ester plus ionomycin that bypass the proximal TCR signaling defect can preserve proliferation. The characteristic phenotype includes markedly reduced or absent CD8+ T cells with quantitatively preserved but functionally impaired CD4+ T cells.

nearest_material_review.tested_construct: Octreotide is a somatostatin analogue that suppresses growth hormone secretion. Somatostatin receptors are G protein-coupled receptors that signal through inhibitory G proteins; a major downstream effect is inhibition of adenylyl cyclase with reduced intracellular cAMP. Somatostatin-receptor activation also reduces intracellular calcium and promotes other inhibitory signaling, collectively decreasing hormone secretion.
